metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}?action=Stop (SINGULAR path — distinct from both the singular .../deployment create endpoint and the plural .../deployments bulk-rank endpoint). Canonical docs say 202 Accepted with an empty body; confirmed on the wire — Content-Type and Content-Length both came back empty/zero, no body bytes at all. Captured with one live deployment already present under the update+org group (the endpoint targets the update+org-group pair's rollout state, not a specific deployment).
